name: Boxer Retail Ltd.
summary: Boxer Retail Ltd. manages a network of supermarkets situated across Southern Africa. This firm primarily serves lower-to-middle-income populations in urban, peri-urban, and rural settings within South Africa and Eswatini, offering them budget-friendly products and services. Its operational scope is segmented specifically into the regions of South Africa and Eswatini. The company, established in 1977, maintains its head office in Westville, South Africa.
